subject: ONE female spotted hyena, grey work shirt-apron, weary toothy grin; she/her
second_characters: ONE rat in a blue apron, envelope in paw from the first beat
props: ONE thick tow rope; THREE zinc buckets; ONE plain envelope; ONE coin; TWO blue aprons on the washing line
environment: workshop yard by day: workbenches, tools on the wall, a fence lined with sparrows, a washing line of flapping overalls, a grinder sparking at the far bench, cobbles
motion_rule: the hyena moves her WHOLE body every beat. She fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where her face, a bucket or the envelope fills the whole frame. The camera orbits her, changing angle and shot size every beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.3; no words 1.45-1.9, 3.1-3.6, 5.0-5.4; last word by 6.6; no words after 6.6
audio.lip_sync: the hyena speaks, jaw working on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: tya-NU za tra-IKH. PLA-tyat za ad-NU. dva-IKH sa-kra-TI-li. CHIS-lyat-sya na MNE
audio.sfx: bucket scrape, rope twang, coin clink, grinder whine

timeline.a: the hyena springs up, throwing a tow rope over her shoulder
the hyena digs in, hauling the rope paw over paw, three zinc buckets scraping toward her, jaw working on every syllable; near foreground: flapping overalls
close-up: the rope jerks the hyena onto her toes; the last bucket bounces off a cobble into the lens, filling the frame
the hyena snatches the envelope from the rat's paw and rips it open, jaw working on every syllable; a coin drops in the dust
close-up: the hyena thrusts the torn empty envelope into the lens, shaking it, paper filling the frame
the hyena rips two blue aprons off the washing line and flings them over her shoulders, jaw working on every syllable; near foreground: flapping overalls
the rat yanks the apron ties tight behind the hyena; her eyes bulge, tongue pops out, knees buckle
in three aprons, the hyena throws her whole weight into the rope, claws digging dust, buckets grinding forward, jaw working on every syllable
the rope snaps with a twang, flinging the buckets up; the hyena somersaults forward over the yard, aprons flying; the camera hurls itself from far to her, background rushing
the hyena pops up on her hind legs, catching two falling buckets, the third bucket's handle in her jaws, clank
the hyena spins round on her hind legs to the rat, buckets swinging, aprons flapping; near foreground: sparrows burst off the fence
the rat picks the coin from the dust and flicks it into the bucket in the hyena's jaws, clink; her whole body sags
close-up: the coin's weight folds the hyena's knees; she pitches face-first into the lens, bulging eyes over the bucket in her jaws filling the frame

negative_prompt: text, digits, subtitles, watermark, zoom, slow push-in, static wide shot, two characters standing still, a table, a pulley, a hook, belt, conveyor, rail cart, a hero running at the camera, a closed mouth while speaking, a line said twice, an inserted word, speech after 6.6, foreign accent, masculine word endings, duplicate props, floating objects
